title: Zesty Moroccan Stilton Tagine
description: A cultured and molten Moroccan dish featuring Stilton cheese, this recipe is a unique hangover cure that combines the flavors of Morocco with the richness of cheese, shaped into nigiri-like portions for a fun and diabetic-friendly meal, served from a fondue pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Crumble the Stilton cheese into the fondue pot and stir until melted and smooth.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Use a spoon to shape the tagine into nigiri-like portions.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
